CURRENTS

An interactive atlas of the eight Jungian cognitive functions — processes brought to life through dynamic visual physics and energy economics.

Enter the Playground → Build a psyche from the eight, drop it into a situation, and read what each action actually costs it. Energy Economics → All eight on one axis. What an invocation costs turns out to be set by stack position, not by which function you are running — which is only visible with the eight side by side. Phenomena → Loops, grips, the shadow register and the slower things that take decades — what a stack does when it goes wrong, with every claim tagged by where it comes from.
Introverted Thinking

Ti — The Lattice

A crystalline structure of inner coherence, endlessly testing inputs and refining its framework.

Explore Ti → Introverted Feeling

Fi — The Nebula

A quiet nebula around a core tone, weighing experiences against an unargued inner compass.

Explore Fi → Extraverted Intuition

Ne — The Spark Tree

One stimulus erupting into a branching tree of possibilities, forking faster than it finishes, sparks escaping the chamber.

Explore Ne → Introverted Intuition

Ni — The Convergence

Many faint streams funnelled into one point, held quiet for a long while, then flaring into a single whole answer.

Explore Ni → Extraverted Sensing

Se — The Naked Eye

A wide-open iris in direct contact with the live field — the world through it sharper and more saturated than the world beside it, and none of it kept.

Explore Se → Introverted Sensing

Si — The Still Pool

A sealed pool banded with sediment strata — every drop of the present sinks to the layer it matches, and the whole ring lights when past and present agree.

Explore Si → Extraverted Thinking

Te — The Scaffold

Structure thrown up against the world, sorting what works from what doesn't and building toward the flag.

Explore Te → Extraverted Feeling

Fe — The Resonance Field

A ring of other people, coupled by a lattice drawn between them — and a centre that takes its colour from whoever is in the room.

Explore Fe →
